tool.name: Kaptive 3: Assembly
tool.description: K/O loci typing from genome assemblies
tool.command:
#import re
#if $formats.output_type == "directory": #set $output_path = "fasta_output" mkdir -p '$output_path' && #elif $formats.output_type == "single_file": #set $output_path = "kaptive_results.fasta" #end if
#set $assembly_fasta = [] #for $fasta in $input_fasta: #set $safename = re.sub('[^\w\-_\.]', '_', $fasta.element_identifier) #if not $safename.endswith('.fasta') #set $safename = $safename + '.fasta' #end if ln -s '$fasta' '${safename}' && #silent $assembly_fasta.append($safename) #end for
kaptive assembly '$db' #for $fa in $assembly_fasta: ${fa} #end for #if $formats.output_type == "single_file": --fasta '$output_path' #elif $formats.output_type == "directory": --fasta '$output_path' #end if --out '$tabular_results' #if $json_output: --json '$json_results' #end if --min-cov $advanced.min_cov --score-metric $advanced.score_metric --weight-metric $advanced.weight_metric --n-best $advanced.n_best --max-other-genes $advanced.max_other_genes --percent-expected $advanced.percent_expected --gene-threshold $advanced.gene_threshold #if str($advanced.below_threshold) == "true": --below-threshold $advanced.below_threshold #end if && 2>&1

param.name: output_type
param.label: Output type
param.option: Multiple fasta files in a collection

param.name: min_cov
param.label: Minimum gene %coverage
param.help: Minimum gene %coverage (blen/q_len*100) to be used for scoring (default: 50.0)

param.name: weight_metric
param.label: Weighting metric
param.help: Weighting for the 1st stage of the scoring algorithm (default: 3)

param.name: n_best
param.label: Number of best loci to align
param.help: Number of best loci from the 1st round of scoring to be fully aligned to the assembly (default: 2)

param.name: max_other_genes
param.label: Max other genes
param.help: Typeable if less than or equal to other genes (default: 1)

param.name: percent_expected
param.label: Min % expected genes
param.help: Typeable if greater than or equal to % expected genes (default: 50)

param.name: below_threshold
param.label: Allow below threshold
param.help: Typeable if any genes are below threshold (default: False)

tool.help:
**Kaptive Assembly Tool**
This tool types bacterial assemblies using a Kaptive database, performing locus identification and typing.
**Inputs:**
- **Database path or keyword**: Path to the Kaptive database directory or a predefined keyword - **Assembly files**: One or more assemblies in FASTA format (.fasta, .fasta.gz, .fasta.xz, .fasta.bz2)
**Output Options:**
- **Tabular results (-o)**: Output file to write/append tabular results to - **FASTA output (-f)**: Turn on FASTA output for sequences - **JSON lines output (-j)**: Turn on JSON lines output - **Score matrix output (-s)**: Dump locus score matrix to TSV (typing will not be performed!) - **Plot results (-p)**: Generate plots of results - **Plot format (--plot-fmt)**: Choose between PNG or SVG for plots - **Suppress header (--no-header)**: Suppress header line in output
**Scoring Options:**
- **Minimum coverage (--min-cov)**: Minimum gene %coverage to be used for scoring (default: 50.0) - **Score metric (--score-metric)**: Metric for scoring each locus - 0: AS (alignment score of genes found) - 1: mlen (matching bases of genes found) - 2: blen (aligned bases of genes found) - 3: q_len (query length of genes found) - **Weight metric (--weight-metric)**: Weighting for the 1st stage of scoring - 0: No weighting - 1: Number of genes found - 2: Number of genes expected - 3: Proportion of genes found - 4: blen (aligned bases of genes found) - 5: q_len (query length of genes found) - **Number of best loci (--n-best)**: Number of best loci from 1st scoring round to fully align (default: 2)
**Confidence Options:**
- **Gene threshold (--gene-threshold)**: Species-level gene identity threshold. (i.e Klebsiella K locus - 82.5%, Klebsiella O locus - 82.5%, A.baumannii K locus - 85%, A.baumannii OC locus - 85%) - **Maximum other genes (--max-other-genes)**: Typeable if <= other genes (default: 1) - **Percent expected (--percent-expected)**: Typeable if >= % expected genes (default: 50) - **Below threshold (--below-threshold)**: Typeable if any genes are below threshold (default: False)
